mud-0.mp3, stone-0.mp3, paper-0..1.mp3:
Different steps on wood, stone, leaves, gravel and mud by TinyWorlds,
edited from public-domain pdsounds.org recordings.
https://opengameart.org/node/5701
License: CC0 1.0
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The leaf recordings are used as soft paper/wing rustles.

Puddle Walker edits: selected individual takes, mono 32 kHz MP3 encoding,
65 Hz rumble removal and 3 ms onset fades. Runtime mixes, levels and subtly
varies recorded takes according to actual shoe contact. No author endorsement
is implied. No synthesized tones or continuous noise loops are used.
